title: Infantry (11 Series) Career Handbook
subcopy: For 11A, 11B, 11C, and 11Z. Build a civilian résumé from the work you actually did, compare career paths and their requirements, and practice telling your story in interviews.

samples.caption: A complete sample résumé you can adapt
Sentence-level résumé editing and translation tables

whatsInside: Dedicated tracks for 11B, plus 11C, 11Z, and 11A officers — and how the 11X accession code fits
A career atlas of direct, adjacent, and unexpected civilian paths, with entry points, education, credentials, and experience
Two complete sample résumés (training coordinator and operations coordinator) you can adapt
Sentence-level résumé editing — translate tasks into results without inflating claims
A cover-letter system with two full example letters
Outreach and networking email templates that respect people's time
Interview prep: realistic questions, written answer practice, and hands-on activities
Federal applications and veteran hiring paths
Worksheets throughout, plus a verified research directory
